**Master your Hifz and never let a memorized verse slip away.**

Murajah (مراجعة) is an elite, feature-rich Quran companion engineered specifically for memorization (Hifz) and systematic review. Combining intelligent revision scheduling, precise analytics, 100% offline capability, and three pristine reading surfaces, Murajah equips you with a professional-grade toolkit to safeguard your Quranic journey.

Memorizing the Quran is a monumental spiritual achievement, but maintaining it is the true test. Murajah transforms this lifelong commitment into a structured, measurable, and deeply rewarding daily habit.

---

### ✨ Core Features Designed for Mastery

**📖 Immersive Reading Surfaces**

* **Madani (QPC) Mushaf:** Authentic Uthmani script featuring toggleable, full color-coded Tajweed and legends.
* **IndoPak Nastaleeq:** A dedicated, first-class layout tailored specifically for the subcontinent tradition.
* **Scanned Mushaf Mode:** Experience the tactile feel of printed pages with single-page mobile views, true two-page desktop spreads, and seamless pinch-to-zoom.
* **Customizable Comfort:** Adjustable text sizes, Light/Dark/Sepia reading themes, and flawless RTL support.

**🧠 Adaptive Planning & Smart Revision**

* **Dynamic Daily Plans:** Not just a static checklist. Get adaptive plans that combine your reading scope, pace, and new memorization targets.
* **Weakness-Aware Scheduling:** The app learns your weak spots and prioritizes pages that require urgent review.
* **Mistake-Marking Mode:** Flag specific words you consistently miss so you can revisit and perfect them.

**📊 Deep Analytics & Progress Tracking**

* **Visual Heatmaps:** Color-coded grids and page-by-page heatmaps give you an instant overview of your Juz-level progress and retention strength.
* **Performance Metrics:** Track perfect-revision counters, weakness scores, and projected completion dates based on your unique pace.
* **Daily Streaks:** Stay accountable with a dedicated "Today" view, streak tracking (midnight reset), and comprehensive historical logs.

**🔤 Granular Word-Level Tools & Tafsir**

* **Advanced Morphology:** Tap any word to inspect its full Arabic grammar breakdown and word-by-word translation.
* **Integrated Tafsir:** Access inline commentary in Arabic, English, and Bengali—toggleable per page without ever leaving the reader.

quotes.text:
Experimenting with various AI models via GitHub Co-Pilot on an extremely niche project to see how far these models have progressed. Used like ~60% of the premium quota to develop the following projects:

website: https://murajah.pages.dev/

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.murajah.webview

Manual audio splitting tool for the above project: audio-splitter-6b3.pages.dev/

I've always been skeptical of AI-generated code. This is my first experiment with AI agents, where the full code base, implementation, debugging, and deployment are done using AI Agents MCPs.

Used VS Code all the way, i.e., all the source codes, including the code to generate the Google Play Store APK. I only reviewed the source code before committing and helped debug by suggesting ideas/algorithms.

Mostly used Claude Haiku 4.5 like 75% of the time, where it failed, switched to the sonnet 4.5 or GPT 5  codex. Interestingly, when debugging, sometimes one model struggled even after numerous iterations/feedback loops, but then the problem was solved instantly as soon as I switched to another model.

The source codes are available here:

https://github.com/wasi0013/Murajah

https://github.com/wasi0013/audio-splitter

Initially, I thought the audio splitting could be done automatically using some AI models from Hugging Face or Whisper. But the audio files have some complex repetitions; the output was miserable.
